programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The heaviest judgments of convicted killers are reserved for those who committed premeditated murder. These women plot and plan. They know the consequences of their actions, but still they go forward to kill.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Greed
programme.desc: Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Behind lace-curtained windows and beneath sensible haircuts lurked evil. Appearances were deceptive. We did not notice these female killers walking by. These women wore a mask of sanity.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: A rifle in a shopping mall, a syringe of potassium chloride and a syringe of insulin, each in the hands of a mentally disturbed woman, lead to the tragic end of many lives.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love to Death
programme.desc: Love and money are a beautiful marriage, for the lucky ones they create a life of happiness and ease. Unless the love is of money, the bride is a killer, and the groom their victim.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: Women are more often prey than predators, but the exceptions are deadly women indeed. In this episode, we’ll discover what drove these deadly women to prey on the unsuspecting.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Love Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Love can be beautiful, love can be blind and love can be deadly. Desire and jealousy are powerful forces driving women to dark and horrifying places in their minds.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Hearts of Stone
programme.desc: Deadly Women are not always the ones you expect. They are not the strangers lurking in the dark, they are a young mother, a supportive wife and a grandmother - all killers. Behind their loving masquerade lies a wake of family horror and pain.

programme.title: Deadly Women
programme.desc: These women burn madly with jealousy, an anger so deep they’ll kill to satisfy it. What makes them turn from “green with envy” to “lethal with jealousy?" Find out as we explore their hearts of darkness.

programme.title: Deadly Women: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Behind their friendly smiles, deadly women hide histories of bloodshed and murder.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Tender Trap
programme.desc: When Dog discovers today's prey is a notorious ladies man, he knows just how to lure him in. The trap includes a suggestive phone call, a motel rendezvous, and a crew of bounty hunters waiting in the next room ready to break up the party!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Greed is Good
programme.desc: Today's fugitive is accused of assaulting a police officer, so Dog and the team are not taking any chances. Dog has to play on his target's greed and deploy some modern technology to set a trap for this runner.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Picture This
programme.desc: A fugitive with a long criminal record has fled to Hawaii, and the bondsman on the mainland has asked Dog for help. Dog doesn't have much information to work with, but he can use the felon's desire to impress his friends to track him down.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tag, You're It
programme.desc: To his traditional bounty hunting tools of confidential informants, canvassing, and silver-tongued subterfuge the world's greatest bounty hunter has added Facebook! A word to the wise for those on the run-post at your own peril, the Dog is watching!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Family Affair
programme.desc: Dog likes to say, "The apple doesn't fall far from the tree," and this is a hunt where that is true. So will Dog be able to use one family member's troubled ways to catch another one in trouble with the law?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Training Day
programme.desc: While the team tries to handle the bond that newcomer Alysin wrote incorrectly, sparks are flying between Beth and Duane Lee when he questions Beth's decision to go on the hunt without Dog leading the charge!

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cutting the Apron Strings
programme.desc: Two different young men both have a bad habit of missing their court dates. Looking over their files Dog senses that they have another trait in common, both are a little too tied to their mothers.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Short Handed
programme.desc: Dog's target today has a history of violence, and apparently plans to re-locate without notifying the proper authorities. Unfortunately the team is missing a key player, Duane Lee is MIA today distracted by his new lady love.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Photo Op
programme.desc: Dog and Duane Lee can't agree about what role Duane Lee should have in the family business. But the family comes together as they set out to hunt a chronic violator with an open warrant and a wife who has an odd request for Dog.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A House Divided
programme.desc: Dog has dropped Duane Lee from the team. When Leland confronts Dog and Beth about the decision tempers flare. But they have to come together to answer a cry for help from a mother who feels that the safest place for her daughter is jail.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All Grown Up
programme.desc: Cecily has graduated from High School and Dog believes the time is right to show her what the family business is all about. The rough and tumble world of bounty hunting is very different than the all girls private school she attended.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fight Like A Girl
programme.desc: This one is close to home. Dog's target on today's hunt is the cousin of Kali, Garry Boy's caregiver. In addition, she has a reputation as a brawler. With Duane Lee still missing from the team Baby Lyssa decides she will step-up in this hunt.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Higher Power
programme.desc: In an attempt to bring the team back together, Dog recruits his pastor, Tim Storey, to be the peacemaker. As Dog begins his hunt for a young man who has trouble showing up at court, Tim has his own mission - convince Duane Lee to meet with him.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound? As the family heads out for the seedier side of Honolulu in search of an erotic dancer, we will find out if the wound is truly healed.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Who's the Boss
programme.desc: When can a bounty hunt also be a date? When Dog and Beth decide to ride in the same SUV as they pursue a run away fugitive, will their different approaches to the investigation lead to a capture and romance?

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bus Stop Bruiser
programme.desc: When an alleged abuser goes on the lame, Dog gathers the team to bring him in. As the leads grow colder Dog's determination only grows stronger. Finally, a hot lead comes in and Dog sets the trap for his prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Luck Be A Lady
programme.desc: Dog and company head to the Big Island in pursuit of two courthouse no-shows only to find that one of them appears to be posting status updates from Southern California.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Behind the Hunt
programme.desc: The cameras are turned around, as we get a tour of life "behind the scenes" on Dog the Bounty Hunter. Using interviews with Dog and the posse, the TV crew, and never before seen footage, this is one of most revealing and heartfelt episodes of the series.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: God Looks on the Heart
programme.desc: This fugitive spells trouble for Dog in today's hunt. When the leads grow cold it's the US Postal Service to the rescue as a mail carrier lends a helping hand. Dog's team surrounds the suspected safe house and silently awaits their prey.

programme.title: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Big Brother

programme.title: Patrick Keane
programme.desc: Originally from the Midwest, raised in Orange County, college in Montana and a three-year stint in Asia make Patrick Keane a comedian with a background. Why college in Montana? Football scholarship. Why Asia? To get away from football.Since moving to Los Angeles in 2000, Patrick has appeared on Comedy Centrals Live At Gotham, the Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, the Bob and Tom show, Comics Unleashed, the Montreal Comedy Festival and is a regular at the Improv and Comedy Store in Hollywood. He was also a cast member on My TV Networks Tony Rock Project. (He was the white guy).When not headlining, Patrick is the opening act for comedians such as Nick Swardson, Joel McHale, Kevin Nealon, Kevin Pollok, Bobby Lee, Henry Phillips, Eddie Gossling and Bil Dwyer. While at home in Los Angeles he studies at the UCB theatre and Lesley Kahn institute. Asked what the key is to comedy, this writer/actor/comedian says, I try not to be funny and it usually works. With multiple appearances on the Late Late show with Craig Ferguson, his record setting viewer ship on Comedy Central, and his ability to tell the difference between people from Ireland and people from Northern Ireland, Patrick is the obvious choice to be the next host of the Oprah Winfrey show.His dry, self-deprecating style originates from influences Bill Murray and Gene Wilder. His favorite stand up comedians are Chris Rock, Lewis Black, Gary Shandling, Jerry Seinfeld and many other female comics not from New York.

programme.title: Rahn Hortman
programme.desc: Rahn credits the earliest influences to his humor to Bill Cosby and Martin Lawrence. Bill Cosby's ability to tackle diverse subject matter without uttering a single curse word, and Martin Lawrence's natural gift of representing the "ordinary guy" combined to form the foundation for Rahn's vision. What resulted is a unique blend of profanity-free banter, with pointed observations about everyday people that leave no one safe.

programme.title: Joe Devito
programme.desc: Joe DeVito's dead-on timing and unexpected twists make him a favorite at comedy clubs across the USA. His TV appearances include The Late Late Show, Last Comic Standing, Comedy Central, Comics Unleashed, and AXStv's Gotham Comedy Live. He's also a regular on TV news panels, finding the funny in pop culture and current events. Joe's albums First Date with Joe DeVito and Three's Comedy are in regular rotation on SiriusXM radio.

programme.title: Josh Fonokalafi
programme.desc: Joshua T Fonokalafi is a Utah based comedian from the mean streets of Ogden, Utahs own Compton. Raised in the Northwest and the son of an Islander immigrant, Joshua tells of his hardships growing up as one of the biggest minorities in the country. Joshua was most recently featured at the Idaho Laugh Fest and is preparing to film his very own comedy special with VidAngel. He's acted in Jackie and Ryan with Katherine Heigl, and in Certain Woman with Laura Dern and Kristen Stewart. Joshua's quick wit and humor will give you an amazing abdominal workout.

programme.title: Jason Hewlett
programme.desc: The Award-Winning One-Man Show of Jason Hewlett The Entertainer will have you laughing until it hurts. Comedy, Music, Impressions, and Standing Ovations make Jason the perfect entertainer. His brand of Hilarious G-Rated Entertainment is unlike anything you have ever enjoyed. Over 2,000 shows for more than 1 Million audience members in his incredible career make Jasonís show an event you will remember for years to come.

programme.title: Dry Bar Comedy
programme.desc: Thirty year comedy veteran Dan St. Paul jokes about acting his age, his Italian heritage, and slowly becoming a cylinder the older he gets.

programme.desc: Spencer has performed all over North America, he has won festivals, and he was recently featured on Fox's television show “Laughs.” Yet now, with the title as a Las Vegas headliner, he brings all of his talents to the stage for a once in a generation experience.

programme.title: Qatar Cross Country Rally - 2020
programme.desc: Manateq Qatar Cross-Country Rally signaled the opening round of the FIA World Cup for Cross-Country Rallies at the stunning, awe-inspiring state of Qatar. Organised by the Qatar Motor and Motorcycle Federation (QMMF), the event has attracted 33 teams and competitors from 17 nations. Five days of intense competition and 1,444.99 kilometres in the challenging Qatar desert, will test cars and drivers to their limits. Although the event has attracted many teams and competitors, the 3-time Dakar winner Nasser Saleh Al-Attiyah stands out prominently. Al-Attiyah has proven to be a force to be reckoned within the cross-country rally scene. Only just missing the mark in the last Dakar Rally, the born and bred Qatari will be keen to compete and impress on home soil.

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E04 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Andalucia Bike Race - 2019
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track...

programme.title: Mountainbike: Cape Epic
programme.desc: S01E04 The Absa Cape Epic is the world's premier mountain bike stage race. The route changes every year, leading aspiring amateur and professional mountain bikers from around the world through roughly 700km of unspoilt scenery and 15 000m of accumulated climbing, over some of the most magnificent mountain passes in Western Cape in South Africa. The Absa Cape Epic is the most televised mountain bike stage race in the world and the only eight-day mountain bike stage race classed as hors catégorie by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). This official UCI status makes it a highlight on the professional racer's calendar. The Absa Cape Epic also attracts aspiring amateur riders wanting to test themselves against the best. It is a full-service race, meaning that everything is taken care of from the start - all riders need to think about is riding.

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mindy and Mork

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Regrets and Reflections

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: The Wedding

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Three The Hard Way

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Mama Mork, Papa Mindy

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: PS 2001

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Metamorphosis - The TV Show

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Drive, She Said

programme.title: Mork & Mindy: Midas Mork

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The interim-GLORY Heavyweight Title will be up for grabs as top ranked heavyweight contender Antonio Plazibat (22-4, 16 KO) collides with the number two ranked Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (24-2-1, 12 KO) in the main event. These teammates will have to put their friendship aside for one night and go head-to-head for GLORY gold. Also on the card are title fights in the Middleweight, Welterweight and Light Heavyweight divisions.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: A four-man one-night heavyweight tournament will take centre stage with the winner punching his ticket into the historic end of year GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix for a chance to win a life-changing $500,000. The four participants are Dutch giant Martin Terpstra (21-5, 11 KO), former light heavyweight title contender Mohamed Amine (29-5, 16 KO), the explosive Bahram Rajabzadeh (62-1, 56 KO), and the bruising power puncher Uku Jürjendal (18-7, 14 KO). A huge international title fight will feature in the co-main event as Tyjani Beztati (24-4, 9 KO) will put his GLORY lightweight championship on the line against Japanese star Kaito Ono (51-6-1, 22 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the main event, featherweight champ Petch (168-39-3, 27 KO) looks to defend his crown for the sixth time when he welcomes the challenge of local hero Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO). The co-main event will see a crucial fight between Romania’s Benjamin Adegbuyi (35-8, 20 KO) and Sofian Laïdouni (35-2-1, 17 KO) of France that will decide who will qualify for the GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix in December.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: A huge title fight rematch will take place in the main event as rivals Tiffany ‘Time Bomb’ van Soest (24-6-2, 9 KO) and Sarah Moussaddak (8-3, 1 KO) lock horns once again. The rest of the card is stacked with some exciting names and thrilling fights. French Algerian Nordine Mahieddine (27-15, 12 KO) collides with France’s Abderahmane Coulibaly (58-20-1, 25 KO) in a big heavyweight contest, Germany’s Denis Wosik (37-8-1, 9 KO) meets the super popular Albanian Berjan Peposhi (27-3, 16 KO), former GLORY title challenger Karim Ghajji (103-17-1, 53 KO) returns and squares-off against Serbia’s Nikola Todorovic (26-3, 14 KO), and Iliass Hammouche (32-6, 7 KO) will finally make his much anticipated debut against Germany’s Florian Kroger (19-9, 6 KO).

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Badr Hari will go head-to-head with Estonia’s Uku Jürjendal in a GLORY Grand Prix Qualifier. Middleweight Champ Petchpanomrung will defend his belt against newcomer David Meija. Bulgarias own, Stoyan Koprivlenski, will face off with Romanian Sorin Caliniuc. Also fighting is Heavyweight Levi Rigters and Luis Tavares makes his return.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The undisputed heavyweight king of kickboxing will be decided in the main event as long reigning champion Rico Verhoeven (60-10, 20 KO) goes up against arguably his most dangerous opponent to date in interim-heavyweight champ Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-2-1, 13 KO). Middleweight champ Donovan Wisse (19-1, 10 KO) puts his title on the line against number one contender Michael Boapeah (16-3-1, 7 KO). Wisse has looked unstoppable so far during his title run but now he faces an in-form Michael Boapeah who holds a win over the only man to beat Wisse. The welterweight division sees top ranked stars go head-to-head as Hamicha (40-2, 30 KO) takes on Diaguely Camara (24-4-1, 10 KO) and Jay Overmeer (29-5, 15 KO) meets Chico Kwasi (41-5, 22 KO). It’s also an important evening at middleweight with Serkan Ozcaglayan (45-8, 36 KO) colliding with Ulric Bokeme (31-4, 17 KO) and the recently debuted Iliass Hammouche (33-6, 7 KO) facing Ivan Galaz (58-10-1, 15 KO). A huge featherweight match-up between the number one ranked Abraham Vidales (15-2, 12 KO) and number two ranked Ahmad Chikh Mousa (58-8-1, 28 KO) plus an exciting light heavyweight bout between Ibrahim El Bouni (41-8-1, 22 KO) and Stefan Latescu (16-2, 7 KO) will round out the main card.

programme.desc: Endy Semeleer (35-1, 17 KO) will put his GLORY welterweight title on the line against ‘House of GLORY’ winner Anwar Ouled-Chaib (3-0) in the main event. programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Doch als dieser sie endlich zu einem Date einlädt, muss sie schockiert feststellen, dass ausgerechnet zu dieser Zeit ein großer 'iCarly'-Auftritt auf einer Comic-Messe ansteht.

programme.title: iCarly: Krieg der Fans – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly ist völlig in Adam verknallt. Als Carly dann Adam dazu einlädt, sie auf eine Comic-Messe zu begleiten, ahnt sie allerdings noch nicht, dass sie in einen äußerst peinlichen Fan-Krieg verwickelt werden wird.

programme.title: iCarly: Und zum Schluss ein Kuss
programme.desc: Carly und ihre Freunde verbringen eine Nacht in der Schule, um ihre Schulprojekte abzuschliessen. Dabei glauben Carly und Freddie, dass sich Sam möglicherweise in den neuen Jungen namens Brad verknallt haben könnte.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 1
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: iParty With Victorious – Teil 3
programme.desc: Carly und Tori finden heraus, dass sie sich beide mit dem gleichen Typen treffen – und die erzürnten Mädchen holen natürlich sofort zum Gegenschlag aus.

programme.title: iCarly: Es gibt Zoff!
programme.desc: Carly muss ständig zwischen Freddie und Sam vermitteln.

programme.title: iCarly: Die Liebe und der Wahnsinn
programme.desc: Carly findet heraus, dass Sam sich in eine Nervenheilanstalt hat einweisen lassen, weil sie glaubt, wegen ihrer Sympathie für Freddie verrückt zu sein. Da sie nicht aus der Anstalt herauskann, fragt sich die Gang, wie sie sie herausbekommen.

programme.title: iCarly: Das Nerd-Camp
programme.desc: Als Gibby einen Plan ausheckt, um Sam und Freddie zu trennen, deckt Mrs. Benson deren Beziehung auf. Wird sich Carly für Sam und Freddie einsetzen oder Gibby dabei helfen, sie auseinander zu bringen?

programme.title: iCarly: Zu dumm
programme.desc: Carly will ihren neuen Schwarm damit beeindrucken, indem sie sich schlauer gibt als sie eigentlich ist. Währenddessen hilft der Rest der Truppe T-Bo dabei, ein neues zu Hause zu finden, weil er aus dem 'Groovy Smoothie' geschmissen wurde.

programme.title: iCarly: Besuch der First Lady
programme.desc: Die Kids wollen Carlys Vater eine Online-Geburtstagsparty schmeißen. Doch als sie sich in ein gesichertes Netzwerk einhacken, bekommen sie Ärger von einer wichtigen Informationsagentur des Landes.

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 1
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Kids erfahren, dass Nora Dershlit aus dem Knast freikommen soll. Was können sie tun, damit ihre ehemalige Peinigerin hinter Gittern bleibt?

programme.title: iCarly: Psycho-Nora kehrt zurück – Teil 2
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang muss einen Weg finden, vor Nora und ihren verrückten Eltern zu fliehen.

programme.title: iCarly: Im Butterkuchen-Himmel
programme.desc: Alle außer Carly gehen zur Kanadischen Kuchenfabrik, doch Sam darf nicht wieder in die USA einreisen. Unterdessen macht sich Carly ausgehfertig für ein Date.

programme.title: iCarly: Oh weh, 3D!
programme.desc: Freddie will seine kreative Seite spielen lassen und entscheidet sich iCarly in 3D zu senden. Spencer stellt einen Assistenten an, den er nicht bezahlen kann.

programme.title: iCarly: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.sub-title: Pleiten, Pech und noch mehr Patzer
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, der bei 'Victorious' den Charakter 'Rex' spielt, interviewt die Stars von iCarly und zeigt die besten Outtakes der Staffel.

programme.title: iCarly: Action mit One Direction
programme.desc: Nach einem Urlaub hat sich Carly eine ansteckende Krankheit eingefangen. Leider steckt sie ein Mitglied der Band One Direction an. Spencer soll mit einem kleinen Mädchen trainieren, das keine Lust hat Sport zu treiben.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibbys Traum
programme.desc: Mithilfe von Sam eröffnet Gibby im Keller der Schule ein geheimes Restaurant. Unterdessen designt Spencer einen Sicherheitsroboter fürs Loft. Doch der Roboter spielt plötzlich verrückt!

programme.title: iCarly: April, April ...
programme.desc: Es ist der 1. April! Carly und Spencer sollen aus ihrer Wohnung zwangsgeräumt werden, also teilen die Freunde ihre gemeinsamen Erlebnisse in der Wohnung. Doch wir erinnern uns etwas anders.

programme.title: iCarly: Plötzlich Verkäuferin
programme.desc: Freddies neuer Traumjob im Pear Store wird zum Albtraum sobald Sam auch angeheuert wird. Unterdessen will Carly, dass einer ihrer Kollegen sie nach einem Date fragt und Spencer muss bei der Freiwilligen Feuerwehr ehrenamtlich arbeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Happy Hälft-o-ween!
programme.desc: Die iCarly-Gang schmeißt eine 'Hälft-o-ween' Party, weil Halloween so toll ist, dass es am besten zweimal im Jahr gefeiert werden sollte! Doch die Party gerät außer Kontrolle als ein kostümierter Gast Carly und ihren Freunden einen Streich spielt.

programme.title: iCarly: Chip, Chuck & Spencer
programme.desc: Gibbys neues Spielzeug geht kaputt, doch Freddie repariert es ihm und legt noch einen oben drauf. Spencer versucht einem rachsüchtigen Kind mit allen Mitteln das Handwerk zu legen.

programme.title: iCarly: Hausverbot
programme.desc: Carly verbietet T-Bo einen Fuß in die Wohnung zu setzen. Er revanchiert sich, indem er sie aus dem Groovy Smoothie verbannt. Freddie und Gibby entdecken die Vorzüge einer Band anzugehören. Doch Pflichten bringt es auch mit sich.

programme.title: iCarly: Ausflug nach Vegas
programme.desc: Als Sam erfährt, dass ihre Mutter in Las Vegas im Gefängnis sitzt, packt die Truppe ihre wertvollsten Sachen ein und verpfändet sie, um Geld für die Kaution aufzutreiben. Gastdarsteller: die Besetzung der History-Channel-Serie 'Die Drei vom Pfandhaus'.

programme.title: iCarly: Brave Mädchen, böse Mädchen
programme.desc: Sams Freundin wird aus dem Jugendgefängnis entlassen, und Sam rät allen, sich von ihr fernzuhalten. Doch Carly hört nicht auf sie und traut sich zu viel zu. Im Loft findet Spencer eine Nachtsichtbrille.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 1
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Gibby schockiert Amerika – Teil 2
programme.desc: Talkshow-Legende Jimmy Fallon lädt die Crew von iCarly ein, live in seiner Show in New York zu performen. Doch live auf Sendung schockiert Gibby durch ein Hosen-Missgeschick die ganze Welt und bringt beide Shows in große Schwierigkeiten.

programme.title: iCarly: Freunde für Spencer
programme.desc: Die Truppe zieht los, um für Spencer Freunde in seinem Alter zu suchen. Sie finden schließlich ein paar vielversprechende Kandidaten. Aber werden sie auch wirklich zu Freunden?

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 1
programme.desc: Als Spencer an einem für Carly wichtigen Abend Fieber bekommt, versucht er, seine Krankheit vor ihr zu verstecken. Sam restauriert ein Motorrad, und Freddie bekommt ein peinliches neues Handy.

programme.title: iCarly: Ciao Carly – Teil 2
programme.desc: Carly hat sich gerade damit abgefunden, dass sie nicht zum Ball gehen wird, als ihr Vater plötzlich auftaucht, um mit ihr hinzugehen. Carlys Abend nimmt eine weitere unerwartete Wendung, als ihr Vater ihr eine lebensverändernde Frage stellt.

programme.title: iCarly: Miss Briggs sagt 'No!'
programme.desc: Mitgefangen, mitgehangen: Carly muss ausbaden, dass sich ihre beste Freundin und Banknachbarin Sam in der Schule mal wieder einen Streich erlaubt hat.

programme.title: iCarly: Eine leuchtende Idee
programme.desc: Carly hat die Idee, einen Wettstreit zu veranstalten und die Zuschauer online über den Sieger abstimmen zu lassen. Es geht darum, welches Team die beste Idee hat, wie man mehr Zuschauer für iCarly gewinnen kann.

programme.desc: Un agente detiene a un sospechoso, quien intenta huir y esconder un delito. Un conductor nos recuerda por qué no debemos prestar el auto a un amigo intoxicado. Un hombre no deja de mentir a los oficiales cuando es interrogado por un choque.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Un sospechoso se hace el tonto cuando los oficiales intentan hacer coincidir un arma abandonada con su funda vacía. Malas decisiones en un parqueadero inspiran una lección. Los policías ven que los buenos vecinos si existen.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Viendo una buena oportunidad un sospechoso va a las carreras. Se atrapa a un hombre con objetos desagradables. Se atrapa a un hombre en una operación encubierta, aun así, no admite su crimen.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Una madre con una orden judicial no logra evadir a la policía. Se detiene a un delincuente de tránsito habitual. Se reporta una pelea y los policías encuentran evidencia de una discusión sangrienta.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Se persigue a un hombre en un ciclomotor chatarra que no corre más de 40mph. Una mujer culpa a su previa relación tóxica por lo que hay en su auto. Un conductor errático pone a los oficiales en alerta.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives
programme.desc: Tres cabellos... fibras microscópicas... una bolsa de basura común arrancada de un rollo. Pistas aparentemente pequeñas e insignificantes se convierten en los testigos silenciosos de una víctima.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives
programme.desc: Cuando un secuestro se convierte en asesinato, la ciencia forense es la única clave para hacer justicia por las víctimas de las intenciones mortales de un secuestrador.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives
programme.desc: La resolución de delitos puede comenzar con la intuición visceral, pero la ciencia avanzada proporciona pruebas irrefutables a los investigadores.

programme.title: Los nuevos detectives
programme.desc: El análisis balístico es la clave para encontrar a los asesinos que disparan a sus víctimas. Cada disparo deja su propia "huella digital", lo que permite a los científicos ubicar a los asesinos con una precisión mortal.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: En Henderson, un suburbio de Las Vegas, dos ladrones que portaban rifles de asalto emboscaron y asesinaron a dos guardias armados mientras salían con un camión en marzo de 2000 y robaron miles de dólares.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: En la década de los ochenta, el Departamento de Policía de la Ciudad de Nueva York estaba perdiendo la batalla contra las drogas.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: Un día que comenzó con un paseo escolar al campo terminó con la peor pesadilla para los padres. Una niña de once años había desaparecido. Sus padres estaban seguros de que no se trataba de una huida.

programme.title: Los archivos del FBI
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de la primera captura del FBI de un terrorista internacional libanés. En junio de 1985, el terrorista y sus cuatro cómplices secuestraron el avión de una aerolínea poco después de despegar de Beirut.

programme.title: Cops en español
programme.desc: Una persecución a alta velocidad acaba de repente con una vuelta equivocada. La policía interviene cuando un enamorado plantado no capta el desprecio. Un hombre nervioso intenta ocultar su crimen.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Bermuda Turtle Project"
programme.desc: Follow the team as they capture and release wild green sea turtles in a bid to study their health and populations before fitting a satellite tag to a mature specimen that will collect vital data on it’s oceanic migrations.

programme.title: Ocean Vet S1 - "The Sixgill Shark"
programme.desc: Watch Neil and Choy bring the shark to the side of the boat and work in testing conditions to remove dozens of hooks, cut steel lines and attach a tracking tag before Neil swims this massive shark back to the deep ocean.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "The Wild Life:Life On The River’s Edge"
programme.sub-title: The Wild Life:Life On The River’s Edge
programme.desc: Follow the life-giving river and its unusual water dwellers, from the massive Nile hippo and river otter to the giant anteater and bush dog.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Variety Show!:The Top Misconceptions in the Animal Kingdom"
programme.sub-title: Variety Show!:The Top Misconceptions in the Animal Kingdom
programme.desc: Let’s set the record straight on some surprising animal myths, including dolphins as fish, bald eagles as bald, and the idea that there’s only one kind of elephant.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Wings & Butterflies!"
programme.desc: Come along with the colorful butterfly as we learn what it eats, how it lives, and what makes its graceful flight possible.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Birds Of Prey"
programme.desc: Take to the skies with eagles, hawks, and owls as they hunt, fly, and use their remarkable senses and adaptations to capture prey.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "The Wild Life:Life’s A Crowd"
programme.desc: Which animals are the most social? Join meerkats, prairie dogs, and mongooses to see why animals live together in herds, hives, and families.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Wings? Who Needs Wings?!"
programme.desc: Meet the flightless penguins! A look at how penguins live and survive.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Who’s At The Zoo, Too?"
programme.desc: Revisit special zoo animals like Cinder the hairless chimpanzee and Scooby the mane-less lion, and see how zoos help animals survive.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride S1 - "Strike Force!"
programme.desc: We get a first peek at the adorable additions in the denning enclosure. Lewa and Laili take their hunting skills to a new level and tackle a kudu. Also, Kwali takes a nasty bite to the cheek. Can she hang onto her prize?

programme.title: Asia's Deadliest Snakes
programme.desc: Snakes are one of the most feared creatures on the planet and Asia is a hotspot for bites! But which is the deadliest? And should we be truly afraid?

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Mischievous Mammals"
programme.desc: Track nature's biggest troublemakers, from creatures that steal eggs from crocodiles to those that dig fake holes to trick predators.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "The “Bear” Necessities"
programme.desc: Study the planet's most feared and revered predators, covering everything from adorable pandas to fearsome grizzlies.

programme.title: Zoo Clues S3 - "Life On The Reef"
programme.desc: Dive into coral reefs to explore a bustling underwater ecosystem packed with tiny creatures and fierce apex predators.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Fang’s Market"

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Monkey Catcher"

programme.title: The Last Mahout

programme.title: Fish Wars

programme.title: Roseland
programme.desc: JuJu, is a young man who grew up in the Roseland community all his life. Him and his best friend, Good-Game, go on a wild summer spree of sheisty exploits, causing the entire hood of petty thugs to chase them on a rollercoaster ride of wild escapades. Life takes a fateful turn when the love of his life, and everyone who cares about him, try to advise him to slow down his wild ride.

programme.title: Queen of the Trap House
programme.desc: When Kionna is asked to step in and take control of her jailed boyfriend, Tyreek's, drug empire, she reluctantly agrees, but her new position as Queen of the Trap House suits her more than expected.

programme.title: Queen of the Trap House 2: Taking the Throne
programme.desc: Kionna has taken full control of her dead boyfriend's drug empire. She has taken the throne to become the official Queen of the Trap House. However, a new man steps into her life causing her to shift focus away from the criminal enterprise. Kionna also begins dealing with new enemies from rival drug gangs to law enforcement. Kionna will now need to show everyone what a true Queen does to maintain power.

programme.title: Princess of the Trap House
programme.desc: When a local drug dealer is arrested and put in jail, he asks his daughter Diamond to run his operation. Diamond takes control of the empire, however it doesn’t sit well with members of the crew. Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: His Masterpiece
programme.desc: Victoria and Richard are divorced spouses that operate an art gallery together. After meeting young artist Daniel at a community event, they decide to collaborate with him on the exhibit to generate income for their tax obligations. However, Richard's aggressive nature and ulterior motives soon come to light, leading to a dangerous jealousy within him.

programme.title: Born Again Baddie
programme.desc: Following a tragic car accident that claimed her mother’s life and left her father paralyzed, Nia is desperate and forced into a life of crime. After expanding her business and becoming the queen pin of the city, tragedy strikes and it forces her to find solace and reflection on her past life choices.

programme.title: He'll Still Never Let Go
programme.desc: In the wake of her abusive ex-boyfriend Karlton's disappearance, Candace seeks a fresh start. Just as she begins to open her heart to new love, Brandon, his reckless actions inadvertently expose her to danger, unaware that Karlton is silently watching. With her past closing in and her safety at risk, Candace must confront her deepest fears and fight to reclaim her freedom before Karlton's sinister plans destroy her chance at happiness.

programme.title: The Last Eyewitness
programme.desc: After a violent money exchange in a remote forest leaves several people dead, Riley becomes the only witness to a ruthless crime boss's return. Hunted through the wilderness, she must outlast her pursuers to survive.

programme.title: Hated By Many Loved By None
programme.desc: After a violent robbery and a shocking betrayal from her incarcerated husband, Jahzara is forced to fend for herself in a world she was never meant to lead. With her closest friends, Tomeka and Honey, by her side, she steps into the drug game, determined to rebuild her life. But as money, power, and new connections take over, loyalty quickly turns into betrayal.

programme.title: The Sermon
programme.desc: When a charismatic pastor’s sermons begin to influence a group of men searching for purpose, their actions evolve into a series of calculated crimes carried out in the name of righteousness.

programme.title: The Groomsman
programme.desc: A co-ed bachelor and bachelorette getaway at a secluded Airbnb spirals into a night of fear and suspicion when Savanna’s former love unexpectedly arrives as a groomsman in her upcoming wedding to Bryce. As tensions rise and unsettling events begin to unfold, it becomes clear that someone is manipulating the group from the shadows.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the name of Tommy Hicks, who was executed for cowardice and desertion during World War I, is added to the war memorial in Midsomer Parva, the Hicks family are very glad. Henry, the patriarch, is infuriated by the move, having sustained a long-running feud with the Hickses.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The village of Dunstan, leads Barnaby and Jones to investigate the deaths of reclusive couple, Ron and Libby Wilson. Not too far away a fiery dispute is in full swing, between a builder who has a very short fuse and a group of road protesters, protesting about plans for a bypass. With hostilities almost at breaking point, it is not long before another death rocks the village.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When the body of Charlie Finleyson is found in woodland in Midsomer Sonning. Barnaby and Jones begin to scrutinise the employees at the offices of Midsomer Life magazine. It is discovered that Mr Finleyson was married to the ex-wife of Guy Sandys, the wealthy owner of the magazine. The detectives also become aware of a dispute between Guy and the owner of the Morecroft Hotel. With tensions starting to rise between the locals and visitors from London.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a children's magic show, a performer assisting with a trick, is poisoned whilst on stage. It is found that the poison came from a species of Ecuadorean frog. Barnaby and Jones discover that conflict is once again brewing between a village occult guide and enthusiast Ernest Baillol and famous writer Aloysius Wilmington who are both searching for a treasured antique book on the subject.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A team building exercise is imminent planned by a new acting Chief Superintendent John Cotton and Barnaby and Jones are very reluctant to take part. Following an explosion in a truck at a haulage yard, both the detectives see the opportunity as a distraction to investigate. It is not long after that a body is discovered, when a trunk resurfaces from the nearby lake. It is identified as Alec Grainger, a man who had been arguing with James Parkes, the son of Colonel Matt Parkes.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Monks Barton, two couples seemingly disappear from their cottages. When Barnaby and Jones arrive and learn of the legendary, mysterious haunted woods, they remain sceptical. Shortly after a body is found in a shallow grave, answering to the description of one of the 'missing'. The detectives have to delve much deeper into the woods and beyond to find out if ghosts are really to blame or something else.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The villagers of Milton Cross depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton, for their jobs and income. When Sonia Woodley is found murdered in the churchyard, two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, the murder weapon is discovered to be tailor's shears, but which one of villagers is responsible? Barnaby and Jones arrive at Woodley and Woodley, the tailors to find out, to discover that the vicar had received a letter from Sonia a few days before.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a council meeting, Mayor Dave Hicks announces plans to awaken an annual trip to Brighton. Barnaby suspects his proposal to buy coastal land there is a fraud. Barnaby reluctantly joins the party, but during their time in Brighton, hated property developer Hugh Dalgleish is beheaded on a ghost train ride. The detectives together with Tom's cousin DCI John Barnaby gather who from the party or someone else could have been responsible before other murders occur and secrets are uncovered.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Ford Florey is anything but quiet, when the Wild West Society bring their show and fair, consisting of many stalls and a shooting re-enactment. The witch on the 'Dunk the Witch' stall, gets truly dunked and goes horribly wrong, when the water starts turning red. Barnaby and Jones have to be alert with a shooter in their midst. With many grudges, jealousies and a dispute over wasteland, known as 'the swamp', as possible motives, it is not long before more people turn up dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: On a dark night in the village of March Magna, Joyce Barnaby swerves her car and narrowly misses a shadowy figure in the road. Shortly after a body is found in the local old cemetery. The victim Gerald Ebbs was a member of the council and of the village's library. It is discovered from the villagers that Gerald had had a strange fixation on both the old hospital and cemetery; in particular a grave from within.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Devington Manor Winter School led by internationally renowned musician Sir Michael Fielding, is a magnet for many aspiring piano students. When Barnaby and Jones start their enquiries into the possible drowning, they discover many shady connections to the past.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When boxer John Kinsella wins a world title in New York, the village of Midsomer Morchard are overjoyed at his success. Shortly afterwards a solicitor is found dead by his assistant and Kinsella's manager. Barnaby and Jones start to investigate and come across infidelity, anger, betrayals and blackmail. When a Victorian prize-fight re-enactment turns nasty and Kinsella's manager is found murdered in his home's gym.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.desc: A spa weekend at Swavely Manor, proves far from relaxing, when Tom and Joyce Barnaby arrive. programme.desc: The owner of an equestrian centre is trampled by his horse.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Undertaker Patrick Pennyman is found dead in the village of Fletcher's Cross, in his own chapel of rest, by his wife. Barnaby and Scott start looking into a spiritualist church in the village that had been heavily controversial. Elizabeth, a friend of Joyce, who had attended their meetings, tells her that she was suspicious of both the spiritualist church and the undertaker and believed they were acquiring information and stealing from the dead.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Down at the Midsomer Regatta, the day is interrupted by the body of Guy Sweetman, Chairman of the local rowing club, resurfacing midway through a race. Barnaby and Scott learn that Guy was a ladies' man with many past conquests. He had been in secret meetings with a few other members. The two detectives uncover lies, blackmail, jealousy and a planned robbery, before the latest woman Guy was planning to marry is attacked and almost killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a local handyman finds a female classics teacher and a member of a group of orchid enthusiasts poisoned in her own home, DCI Barnaby finds himself heading back to Midsomer Malham, the day after he and Joyce had helped out during the village's annual garden show. It is discovered that the victim had a secret lover and had helped to smuggle a rare one-of-a-kind orchid, the Yellow Roth, out of Borneo.

programme.title: Barbie a kúzelné dvierka
programme.desc: V tomto čarovnom hudobnom dobrodružstve sa nám Barbie predstaví ako bojazlivá princeznička Alexa, ktorá má radšej spoločnosť svojich obľúbených knižiek než starosti mocnej vládkyne. Pri prechádzke kráľovskou záhradou Alexa z ničoho nič objaví tajné dvere, ktoré sa ako vajce vajcu podobajú tým, o ktorých čítala v jednej knihe! Keď ich otvorí a vstúpi, ocitne sa náhle v podivnom čarovnom svete plnom nadprirodzených bytostí a veľmi prekvapivých javov. Spoznáva tu morskú vílu Rómami a suchozemskú vílu Nori. Od nich sa Alexa dozvie, že Malucia, stelesňujúci vládu zla, sa chce násilím zmocniť všetky čarovné sily tohto kraja. Alex neobyčajne prekvapí zistenie, že v tomto svete je aj ona nadaná kúzelnými silami a jej noví priatelia sú presvedčení, že jedine s Alexinou pomocou sa im môže podariť získať späť ukradnuté čáry máry. Sledujte s nami, čo sa stane, až Alexa zoberie všetku svoju odvahu na obranu toho, čo považuje za správne, a naučí sa, že sila priateľstva ľahko zdolá aj mocnú mágiu.

programme.title: Barbie v Luskáčikovi
programme.desc: Barbie tentoraz vďaka neprekonateľnej počítačovej animácii ožije v tejto prekrásnej modernej verzii klasickej rozprávky E. T. A. Hoffmanna v naozaj úžasnéj forme. Rozprávka začína tým, že Barbie, ktorá hrá úlohu Kláry, dostane od svojej najmilšie tety krásnu drevenú bábku - je to luskáčik na orechy - avšak Luskáčik sa ešte tej istej noci, zatiaľ čo Klára spí, stane živým princom, aby dievča ochránil pred zlým Myším kráľom, ktorý prenikol ku Kláre do izby. Dievčatko sa prebudí a Luskáčikovi pomôže, ale Myší kráľ zlým čarom Kláru zmenší. Preto sa musí s Luskáčikom vydať na dobrodružnú cestu, aby našli kňažnú Bonbón, jedine ona totiž dokáže zlomiť zlé čiary myšieho kráľa. Krásu príbehu umocňujú strhujúce tanečné scény, ktoré na príjemnú Čajkovského hudbu vymyslel a nacvičil slávny choreograf Peter Martins. Skutočné pohyby členov Newyorským mestského baletu predvádzajú krásu baletu na televíznej obrazovke spôsobom, ktorý bol doteraz nepredstaviteľný. Barbie v Luskáčikovi divákom...

programme.title: Barbie a dvanásť tancujúcich princezien
programme.desc: Kde bolo tam bolo, hudba plnila zámok kde žilo nie jedna, nie dve, ale dvanásť princezien so svojím milovaným ockom, kráľom. Od najstarších po najmladších, všetkých dvanásť princezien milovalo tanec. Najpôvabnejšou tanečnicou zo všetkých bola siedma princezná, Barbie. Kráľ, premožený výchovou dvanástich energických dcér požiadal o pomoc svoju sesternicu, Rowenu. Chamtivá Rowena rýchlo vyženie radosť z hradu v prestrojení za snahu vychovať z princezien "dokonalé princezné". Už žiadny tanec. Žiadna hudba. Žiadna zábava. Princezné sú z toho nešťastné, až do doby kedy sa Barbie podarí objaviť tajný vchod do magického sveta cez portál v ich spálni. Princezné v ňom nájdu krásny pavilón v krajine zlatých a strieborných stromov. Čarovný prach zo stromov premení ich nočné košele v baletné šaty. V tomto svete môžu konečne princezné robiť to čo najviac milujú... tancovať. Vracajú sa na toto miesto každú noc, tancujúce až do chvíle kedy pretancujú svoje črievice. Každú noc sú znovu a znovu...

programme.title: Balto III: Veľké preteky
programme.desc: Balto a jeho syn Kodi si zrazu uvedomia, že technické výdobytky pomaly začínajú ohrozovať aj budúcnosť polárnych psích záprahov, pretože listy a ostatné zásielky sa do mesta Nome dostanú oveľa rýchlejšie lietadlom než na saniach ťahaných psami. Dochádza k ostrému sporu, ktorý má za následok, že sa konajú poštárske preteky medzi zástancami tradičných saní vedenými Baltom a pilotom menom Duke, ktorého lietadlo Balta veľmi očarilo. Duke do cieľa vôbec nedorazí, a tak sa niekoľko psov začne radovať a jasať, že sa im tak dokonale podarilo dokázať prevahu psieho záprahu, ale Balto tuší, že sa stalo nejaké veľké nešťastie. Preto Balto s pomocou Muka a Luka beží Dukovi a Borisovi na pomoc a snaží sa nájsť zrútené lietadlo. Na tejto ceste, blahodarne pôsobiace na ich duši, môžete záchranca sprevádzať aj vy.

Alex neobyčajne prekvapí zistenie, že v tomto svete je aj ona nadaná kúzelnými silami a jej noví priatelia sú presvedčení, že jedine s Alexinou pomocou sa im môže podariť získať späť ukradnuté čáry máry. Sledujte s nami, čo sa stane, až Alexa zoberie všetku svoju odvahu na obranu toho, čo považuje za správne, a naučí sa, že sila priateľstva ľahko zdolá aj mocnú mágiu.

programme.title: Barbie v Luskáčikovi
programme.desc: Barbie tentoraz vďaka neprekonateľnej počítačovej animácii ožije v tejto prekrásnej modernej verzii klasickej rozprávky E. T. A. Hoffmanna v naozaj úžasnéj forme. Rozprávka začína tým, že Barbie, ktorá hrá úlohu Kláry, dostane od svojej najmilšie tety krásnu drevenú bábku - je to luskáčik na orechy - avšak Luskáčik sa ešte tej istej noci, zatiaľ čo Klára spí, stane živým princom, aby dievča ochránil pred zlým Myším kráľom, ktorý prenikol ku Kláre do izby. Dievčatko sa prebudí a Luskáčikovi pomôže, ale Myší kráľ zlým čarom Kláru zmenší. Preto sa musí s Luskáčikom vydať na dobrodružnú cestu, aby našli kňažnú Bonbón, jedine ona totiž dokáže zlomiť zlé čiary myšieho kráľa. Krásu príbehu umocňujú strhujúce tanečné scény, ktoré na príjemnú Čajkovského hudbu vymyslel a nacvičil slávny choreograf Peter Martins. Skutočné pohyby členov Newyorským mestského baletu predvádzajú krásu baletu na televíznej obrazovke spôsobom, ktorý bol doteraz nepredstaviteľný. Barbie v Luskáčikovi divákom...

programme.desc: Vydajte sa spoločne s Barbie ™ do úplne nového sveta, v ktorom vládnu motýlie víly! ஈவினிங் ப்ரைம்
ఈవెనింగ్ ప్రైమ్
इव्हनिंग प्राईम
programme.desc: The host presents prime news stories, updates and developments on current affairs and socio-political issues in the region.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता क्षेत्र में प्रमुख समाचार, वर्तमान घटनाक्रम और सामाजिक-राजनीतिक मुद्दों पर जानकारी और घटनाक्रम प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
நடப்பு விவகாரங்கள் மற்றும் சமூக-அரசியல் பிரச்சினைகள் குறித்த முக்கிய செய்திகள், புதுப்பிப்புகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ప్రాంతంలోని ప్రస్తుత వ్యవహారాలు, సామాజిక-రాజకీయ సమస్యలపై ప్రధాన వార్తా కథనాలు,విశేషాలు, పరిణామాలను అందిస్తారు.

programme.title: Двое против рыбы ┊ 4
programme.desc: Двое ведущих, находясь на одном водоеме, ловят рыбу разными снастями, выявляя наиболее эффективную из них. Сравнивают уловы, делают выводы, едят на природе и весело шутят. Как выбрать снасти, где найти лучший улов, какие секреты знают настоящие профессионалы? Вы узнаете ответы на эти и многие другие вопросы о рыбалке! Россия

programme.title: От щенка до первого поля ┊ 7
programme.desc: Все о воспитании легавой собаки от момента ее переезда от заводчика к новому хозяину до первых трофеев первого сезона охоты. Обустройство быта щенка, социализация, дрессировка и досуг, как и где гулять со щенком, когда и как начинать знакомить с будущими местами и объектами охоты, натаска, обучение подаче и многое другое. Россия

programme.title: Рыболовная карта Крыма ┊ 3
programme.desc: Путешествие по Крымскому полуострову объединяет знакомство с живописными побережьями Черного и Азовского морей и увлекательную рыбалку. Вместе с местными рыболовами исследуются бухты, берега и малоизвестные акватории, где можно найти перспективные места для ловли. Особое внимание уделено выбору снастей и наживки, погодным условиям, особенностям морской рыбалки и секретам успешного поиска добычи. Россия

programme.title: Утиные истории ┊ 4
programme.desc: Программа предлагает уникальную возможность погрузиться в мир традиционной весенней охоты с подсадной уткой. На протяжении месяца зрители вместе с опытными охотниками из Подмосковья будут изучать тонкости подготовки, организации охоты и ухода за подсадными утками. В программе подробно освещаются нюансы быта охотников, их техники, а также сравнение различных методов и подходов к охоте. Участники расскажут о своих секретах успеха, делая передачу познавательной как для профессионалов, так и для новичков. Россия

Швеция

Это полное погружение в романтику почти крайнего севера: ночевки у костра, строительство самодельных жилищ из подручных средств, холодная красота здешней природы. Ну и, разумеется, охотничьи приключения, в которых зрителю вместе с автором сериала предстоит пробираться на лыжах по глубоким снегам, терпеливо выслеживать добычу, читать следы, приманивать зверей и стрелять. Швеция

programme.title: Абхазская рыбалка ┊ 8
programme.desc: Цикл передач, посвященный рыбалке в республике Абхазия, которую знают все без исключения жители России. Рыбалка в Абхазии интересна своим многообразием – это ловля форели в горах, рыбалка на усача и подуста в низовьях рек, голавль на озере Рица и, конечно же, морская рыбалка, которую всегда приятно совместить с отдыхом. Олег Квициния знает Абхазию как свои пять пальцев. Он с радостью поделится с телезрителями местами и техниками ловли самых разнообразных видов рыбы. Россия

programme.title: От щенка до первого поля ┊ 7
programme.desc: Все о воспитании легавой собаки от момента ее переезда от заводчика к новому хозяину до первых трофеев первого сезона охоты. Обустройство быта щенка, социализация, дрессировка и досуг, как и где гулять со щенком, когда и как начинать знакомить с будущими местами и объектами охоты, натаска, обучение подаче и многое другое. Россия

programme.title: Рыболовные тонкости ┊ 10
programme.desc: Погружение в атмосферу рыбалки, где опытные эксперты делятся ценными советами по выбору снастей, приманок и мест для ловли. Узнайте о современных технологиях, которые делают рыбалку еще увлекательнее, и получите рекомендации по сезонным особенностям поведения рыбы. Откройте для себя лучшие способы повысить результативность и получить настоящее удовольствие от любимого занятия. Россия

programme.title: Что поймали, то едим ┊ 1
programme.desc: От удачного улова до готового блюда – практические советы по работе со свежей рыбой в домашних условиях. Лещ, плотва, густера, уклейка и карась превращаются в аппетитные блюда, домашние консервы и ароматные копчености. Зрители узнают, как правильно подготовить рыбу, подобрать специи для маринада, сохранить полезные свойства продукта и разнообразить привычное меню простыми рецептами

programme.title: Леша, подсекай! ┊ 5
programme.desc: Ведущий программы – мастер спорта, чемпион России по рыболовному спорту ловит рыбу на разных водоемах, применяя широкий спектр доступных всем рыболовам снастей: поплавок, фидер, мормышка, жерлицы. При этом он совмещает приятное с полезным, готовит на природе еду и делится рыболовными секретами. Россия

programme.title: Национальная лига охоты и рыбалки ┊ 7
programme.desc: Ведущий рассказывает об особенностях различных видов охоты, делится практическими знаниями и показывает способы кулинарной обработки добытых трофеев. Зрители увидят весь путь от охотничьего промысла до приготовления блюд из дичи и узнают о традициях и приемах, связанных с использованием охотничьей добычи. Вед.: Евгений Шеляпин. Россия

programme.title: Рыбалка сегодня ┊ 22
programme.desc: Тренировка Дениса Вихрова и Сергея Беляева перед турниром Pro Anglers League на Волгоградском водохранилище. Тактика ловли хищника с лодки поздней осенью. Россия

programme.title: Рыбалка сегодня ┊ 23
programme.desc: Тренировка Константина Кудинова перед турниром Pro Anglers League на Волгоградском водохранилище. Ловля щуки и судака с лодки, поиск стоянок рыбы и роль цветов в джиговых приманках. Россия

programme.title: Охотник-одиночка ┊ 3
programme.desc: Сергей Бешенцев – ведущий этой программы, остается один на один с дикой природой во время охоты и снимает все на камеру в одиночку. Это очень интересно и неповторимо сложно, ведь ему необходимо совмещать съемку с охотой, которая требует внимания, хладнокровия и профессиональных навыков. Вед.: Сергей Бешенцев. Россия

programme.title: Двое против рыбы ┊ 4
programme.desc: Двое ведущих, находясь на одном водоеме, ловят рыбу разными снастями, выявляя наиболее эффективную из них. Сравнивают уловы, делают выводы, едят на природе и весело шутят. Как выбрать снасти, где найти лучший улов, какие секреты знают настоящие профессионалы? Вы узнаете ответы на эти и многие другие вопросы о рыбалке! Россия

programme.title: Рыболовная карта Крыма ┊ 3
programme.desc: Путешествие по Крымскому полуострову объединяет знакомство с живописными побережьями Черного и Азовского морей и увлекательную рыбалку. Вместе с местными рыболовами исследуются бухты, берега и малоизвестные акватории, где можно найти перспективные места для ловли. Особое внимание уделено выбору снастей и наживки, погодным условиям, особенностям морской рыбалки и секретам успешного поиска добычи. Россия

programme.title: Утиные истории ┊ 4
programme.desc: Программа предлагает уникальную возможность погрузиться в мир традиционной весенней охоты с подсадной уткой. На протяжении месяца зрители вместе с опытными охотниками из Подмосковья будут изучать тонкости подготовки, организации охоты и ухода за подсадными утками. В программе подробно освещаются нюансы быта охотников, их техники, а также сравнение различных методов и подходов к охоте. Участники расскажут о своих секретах успеха, делая передачу познавательной как для профессионалов, так и для новичков. Россия

programme.title: Абхазская рыбалка ┊ 8
programme.desc: Цикл передач, посвященный рыбалке в республике Абхазия, которую знают все без исключения жители России. Рыбалка в Абхазии интересна своим многообразием – это ловля форели в горах, рыбалка на усача и подуста в низовьях рек, голавль на озере Рица и, конечно же, морская рыбалка, которую всегда приятно совместить с отдыхом. Олег Квициния знает Абхазию как свои пять пальцев. Он с радостью поделится с телезрителями местами и техниками ловли самых разнообразных видов рыбы. Россия

programme.title: От щенка до первого поля ┊ 7

Обустройство быта щенка, социализация, дрессировка и досуг, как и где гулять со щенком, когда и как начинать знакомить с будущими местами и объектами охоты, натаска, обучение подаче и многое другое. Россия

При этом он совмещает приятное с полезным, готовит на природе еду и делится рыболовными секретами. Россия

Это очень интересно и неповторимо сложно, ведь ему необходимо совмещать съемку с охотой, которая требует внимания, хладнокровия и профессиональных навыков. Вед.: Сергей Бешенцев. Россия

Как выбрать снасти, где найти лучший улов, какие секреты знают настоящие профессионалы? Вы узнаете ответы на эти и многие другие вопросы о рыбалке! Россия

programme.title: Paranormal State: Ghosts of the Forgotten
programme.desc: The PRS investigation into the haunted Lake County Poor House becomes a journey through one PRS team members? troubled past.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Man of the House
programme.desc: PRS is called to help a grandmother and her frightened grandson when renovations on her 19th century house stir up the pipe-smoking specter of a former tenant named Alfred.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Shadow Caster
programme.desc: PRS investigates an Alabama home where clients, Georgiana and her two daughters, are so terrified, they moved out after only 18 months. They have seen shadow figures, been touched and have a recorded EVP stating, "Look at me, get out of here."

programme.title: Paranormal State: Satan's Soldier
programme.desc: Mark and Kim can't sleep through the racket caused by unseen forces in their central Indiana home. When PRS and Psychic/Medium Michelle Belanger discover what appears to be blood in the basement, they investigate a history of violence in the home.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Dark Practice
programme.desc: Brenda is terrified by a dark hooded figure spotted in her West Virginia home. The same entity allegedly tormented her late husband. PRS and Psychic/Medium Michelle Belanger help Brenda before she slips into the same abyss as her late husband.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Haunted Ranch
programme.desc: PRS saddles up to a remote ranch in Hunt, Texas where black shadows are being spotted and animals harmed. What's more, a mysterious crop circle has formed on the property and the horses refuse to cross it.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Paranormal Detour
programme.desc: With time off between cases, Ryan suggests to the PRS team they choose a random town to investigate. They roll into St. Helens, Oregon, home of Twilight, where they learn about the long history of the paranormal in the area.

programme.title: Paranormal State: First Contact
programme.desc: Washington State, a hotbed of unexplained paranormal activity. Between possible UFOs in the sky and winged creatures in the woods, Ryan and his team are forced to face their fears and deal with the question: Are we truly alone in the universe?

programme.title: Paranormal State: Church of the Damned
programme.desc: Jason and his family can no longer do renovations of an abandoned Kansas church, especially after they found their father in the basement crying and frightened because of the menacing activity.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Fire
programme.desc: Christina has been experiencing paranormal activity ever since her father and step-mother were murdered near Columbus, OH last year. PRS and psychic/medium?Chip Coffey delve into a open murder case and wind up exposing a family divide.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Spirits of the Slave Dungeon
programme.desc: Ryan books a two-night case in a real haunted jail in Charleston, SC, but PRS soon realizes the spirits themselves are being held there against their will and subjected to an unjust form of torture.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Name
programme.desc: Ryan Buell and company set out on one of their most dangerous cases to date - to help a single mother who is experiencing paranormal activity in a home that was once the site of brutal murder.

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Asylum
programme.desc: PRS explores a New York State Prison that was once a mental asylum. Ryan and his team go behind bars to uncover the institution's paranormal past and present.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Desperate Households
programme.desc: When Julie and her family moved into their dream home in suburban New Jersey they quickly realized they were not alone.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Vendetta
programme.desc: P.R.S. investigates claims of supernatural revenge in the Pennsylvania Poconos. When a client's new boyfriend moves in, does the paranormal move in with him? Or did her ex put a hex on her house and the entire family?

programme.title: Paranormal State: Lost Souls
programme.desc: PRS and Psychic/medium Michelle Belanger investigate a Pennsylvania home; where a mother named Kathy and her son Michael have both felt the presence of a young boy and hear voices calling, "Mom?" but no one is there.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Hide and Seek
programme.desc: Hillary and her nine-year-old son Hunter are being harassed by a shadow presence in their Victorian home in Newburgh, Indiana. Trap doors in the basement reveal artifacts from a bygone era, and the clients have recorded persistent strange noises.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Woman in the Window
programme.desc: Ryan and his team lend paranormal assistance to a family who lives in a historic home that was once a part of the Underground Railroad. Does the answer to their haunting lie in the mysterious tunnels beneath the house?

programme.title: Paranormal State: The Knickerbocker
programme.desc: PRS checks into the Knickerbocker Hotel in Linesville, Pennsylvania where the owners are reporting strange noises and the appearance of phantom children in some of the rooms.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Laws of Attraction
programme.desc: When Paula's young autistic son Michael, with limited verbal skills uttered the words "Go away scary dead boy" -- it sent a chill up her spine.

programme.title: Paranormal State: Haunted Homecoming

programme.desc: Sarah believes her Parkville, MD home has been invaded by a powerful force ever since her roommate Dennis moved in. PRS investigates claims that Dennis has been attacked by the entity, a possible poltergeist.

programme.desc: When a mirror levitates and shatters on its own, P.R.S. heeds the call to investigate a spirit that has been unleashed on an unsuspecting family. Ryan must track down the spirit and contain it before it does irreparable damage.

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: Da Robert får at vide, at hans bror er omkommet i en bådulykke, tager han af sted for at hente liget og møder Evie Shaw. Han bliver besat af sin brors mistænkelige død... og af Evie. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Cateringfirmaet Carly Westin indvilliger i at tilberede et festmåltid for en veninde. Men parret bliver myrdet, mens hun er i køkkenet. Da politiefterforsker Jack bliver involveret, må han beskytte Carly. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: Da den urolige tvilling Dominique beder sin boglige søster Kimberly om at overtage hendes rolle som glamourøs parisisk model i en måned, tøver Kimberly. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa vågner op på hospitalet, kan hun ikke huske noget: Hun kan ikke huske, hvem hun er, at hendes mand ønsker at lade sig skilles. Da hendes mand tager hende med hjem, må Lisa lære alting forfra. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne mistænker, at hendes bror Alans død ikke var et uheld, og beslutter sig for at undersøge sagen. Hun begynder at arbejde for den magtfulde familie, der muligvis har haft en finger med i spillet. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En forældreløs piges (Mel Harris) søgen efter sin fortid begynder med et barndomsfoto af hende selv ved siden af en sjælden spilledåse og fører hende til en forførende skattejæger. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en smuk barnepige, giver nyt liv til Richard Keaton, en enkemand og videnskabsmand, og hans begavede, men fremmedgjorte søn Andy. Liz' liv er i fare, da hun kommer for tæt på sandheden. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiv Max etterforsker Sandra Applewhites død og er overbevist om at hennes ektemann John Gilman drepte henne. Når han møter Sandras tvillingsøster Nicky, ber han henne om hjelp til å avsløre Gilman. NB Denne filmen vises uten norsketekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny ser aldri på sin kjedelige og lojale assistent Claire Bernard. Men når han oppdager at Claire er en uslipt diamant, bestemmer han seg for å forvandle henne til en fortryllende skjønnhet. NB Denne filmen vises uten norsketekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah og Amy er bestevenner for livet og nå arrangerer de sin første kunstutstilling i en liten by i New England. Når en mystisk fremmed dukker opp, starter et mysterium med narkotika, CIA og Sarahs elskede onkel. NB Denne filmen vises uten norsketekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: Robert får vite om sin brors dødelige båtulykke som får han til å dra for å hente liket. Der møter han Evie Shaw som er eieren av marinaen. Han blir besatt av sin brors mistenkelige død... og av Evie. NB Denne filmen vises uten norsketekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge
programme.desc: Caterer Carly Westin agrees to prepare a feast for a friend who wants to impress a man. But the couple is killed when she is in the kitchen. When police investigator Jack Brannigan gets involved, he must protect Carly before the killer strikes again.

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: When troubled twin Dominique asks her bookish sister Kimberly to assume her role for a month as a glamorous Parisian model, Kimberly hesitates.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: Da Lisa våkner på sykehuset, husker hun ingenting:at mannen hennes Paul vil skille seg fra henne, eller at hun ble brutalt slått og etterlatt for å dø. Når Paul tar henne med hjem, må Lisa lære alt på nytt. NB Denne filmen vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne mistenker at broren Alans død ikke var en ulykke. Hun begynner å jobbe for en familie som kan ha hatt en finger med i spillet, men blir snart forelsket i den eldste sønn. NB Denne filmen vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: När Robert får veta om sin brors båtolycka ger han sig ut för att hämta kroppen och möter Evie Shaw, ägare till marinan där hans bror hyrde båten. Han blir besatt av sin brors misstänkta död ... och av Evie. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Recipe for Revenge

programme.title: Harlequin: A Change of Place
programme.desc: När den oroliga Dominique ber sin bokälskande syster Kimberly att anta rollen som en glamorös parisisk modell i en månad, tvekar Kimberly. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Another Woman
programme.desc: När Lisa vaknar upp på sjukhuset minns hon ingenting: vem hon är, hennes man Pauls avsikt att skilja sig från henne eller att hon blev svårt misshandlad och lämnad att dö i en gränd. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties
programme.desc: Anne Marie Kerr misstänker att hennes bror Alans död inte är en olycka och bestämmer sig för att utreda saken. Hon börjar arbeta för den mäktiga familjen som kan vara inblandad i Alans död. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En föräldralös (Mel Harris) strävan att spåra sitt förflutna börjar med ett barndomsfoto av henne själv bredvid en sällsynt speldosa och leder henne till en förförisk skattjägare. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en vacker barnflicka, ger ny mening åt Richard Keatons liv, en änkeman som blivit vetenskapsman, och hans begåvade son Andy. Liz liv hotas när hon kommer för nära sanningen. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine
programme.desc: Leah og Zac kan ikke finde Zacs dinosaurlegetøj, så Leah beder hendes ånder om at skaffe en erstatning og ender med en vaskeægte apatosaurus!

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren

programme.desc: Der er fart over feltet på det verdensompændende eventyr, når Dora og hendes fætter Diego jagter Boots, som er ført bort af hans kæmpe drage og en voldsom vind. Dora og Diego har brug for din hjælp, til at krydse havet.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Dora og Boots er gået på opdagelse i skoven, da de opdager porten til Eventyrlandet, og går ind i det magiske land. Men...der lever en ond heks i Eventyrlandet.

programme.title: Kom så Diego!
programme.desc: Diego hører pluselig et råb om hjælp. Nogle gøge gør nar af Nandu fordi han ikke kan flyve.

programme.title: Kom så Diego!
programme.desc: Diego og Alicia er på Redningsfarmen, hvor de møder den mexicanske præriehund, Panchita, der skal finde en dejlig prærie fuld af græs til sin familie.

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinerne
programme.desc: Det er det andet holdræs nogensinde – et stort kapløb, som parer biler sammen i racerhold. Og denne gang er Blazes holdkammerat ... Crusher?! Vil Crusher kunne modstå trangen til sine snydemetoder og vinde for allerførste gang?

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.sub-title: Cheep, Chirp, and the Pirate's Treasure / Rod's Family Popcorn Party
programme.desc: Kaptajn Dille hyrer kyllingerne som minipirater for at finde en skattekistenøgle. Kadetterne redder kyllingerne OG piraterne. // Rods lillebror Romeo er blot en 'lille' kylling, indtil de må redde hele Rods familie.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Kadetterne graduerer til et nyt niveau af træning med nye uniformer og nye fartøjer. Mens alle ankommer til ceremonien, ræser kadetterne afsted for at redde Pennys familie på de nye fartøjer, som de endnu ikke har lært at bruge.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Dora små tvillingesøskende er syge og hun vil købe en gave for at muntre dem op. Højt oppe på en hylde i en legetøjsbutik, finder hun en støvet Kasper-i-æsken. [Trold-i-en-æske]

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Det er tvillinge dag, og alle gør sig klar til den store Tvillinge Dags fest i legeparken. Dora har endda en overraskelse til hendes hvalp Perrito. Han har også en tvilling...en længe savnet hvalpe bror han ikke har set, siden de var nyfødte.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Som højdepunktet i Bubbletuckys modeuge, deltager Molly i hurtig-klæde-ud-kampen. Hendes evner får hende på forsiden af 'Klæd dig ud'-bladet, det smarteste modemagasin i byen!

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: Guppyerne tager på tur for at se en koncert med Stillie, en sangsensation, der er kendt for sin fantastiske stil.

programme.title: Rusty Rivets
programme.sub-title: Rusty's Heroic Helpers / Rusty's Monkey Rescue
programme.desc: Bertram og hans nye ven Emily efterligner deres helte, Rusty og Ronja, men ender med at gøre alt værre. // Rusty, Ronja, Bytes og Botarilla finder en fortabt abeunge, og jagten på dens forældre fører dem ud på en farefuld færd.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: Dora og Lene sår Lene's særlige enhjørningeblomster, da en enhjørningeunge, Unicornio, pludselig kommer ridende ind på en regnbue. Den er begejstret for at se Lene's smukke blomster, da de er hans mors yndlingsblomster.

programme.title: Dora Udforskeren
programme.desc: For første gang skal Benny deltage i det store racerløb. Men hans Go-cart går i stykker og falder fra hinanden. Dora og Boots må overbevise Benni om at man ikke skal give op, og hjælper til med at reparere hans Go-Card, så han kan gennemføre løbet.

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinerne
programme.desc: Det er løbsdag og Crusher snyder dobbelt så meget for at slå Blaze og Watts – og sender begge kørere langt væk. Men Blaze og Watts er opsatte på at redde AJ og Gabby og komme tilbage til løbet i tide til at vinde det.
