programme.desc: Fran schlägt Peter vor, nach ihrem Auszug einen Mitbewohner zu suchen. Sie ist jedoch wenig beeindruckt von der potentiellen Mitbewohnerin Jan, die Fran sehr ähnelt.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Assistenz-Chaos
programme.desc: Peter steht vor einem großen Immobiliengeschäft und kann seinen Zweitjob als Joan Collins Assistent nicht wahrnehmen. Fran springt für ihn ein.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Wo die Liebe hinfällt
programme.desc: Marilyns Tochter Kiki ist in der Stadt. Sie ist verlobt, doch als Fran sie überzeugt, dass es auf die Leidenschaft ankommt, lässt Kiki die Hochzeit für den Kellner Carmine platzen. Marilyn ist rasend vor Wut und beschuldigt Fran.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Der neue Nachbar
programme.desc: Fran führt einen Kleinkrieg mit ihrem Nachbarn Neil, weil dieser nachts laute Partys feiert. Außerdem stellt Fran fest, dass ein Teil ihres Blumenladens auf seinem Grundstück steht. Elliot mischt sich ein.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Judis Jugendliebe
programme.desc: Judis alte College-Liebe ist in der Stadt und will ihre gemeinsame Liebe wiedererwecken. Judi ist skeptisch.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Peters Geheimnis
programme.desc: Fran und Judi treffen im Kino auf Peter und seinen Freund Chris, von dem Fran nichts wusste. Peter erklärt ihr warum er das verheimlicht hat. Chris lebt ebenfalls noch bei seinem Ex-Freund.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Peggy
programme.desc: Peters Schwester Peggy kommt überraschend zu Besuch. Fran hat ihr bis heute nicht vergeben, dass Peggy auf Frans und Peters Hochzeit einen Einwand hatte. Die Situation eskaliert, als sich Peggy in die Hochzeitsplanungen einmischt.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Plötzlich Eltern
programme.desc: Fran und Peter sollen auf Cesars Sohn und Neils Tochter aufpassen, doch die beiden verschwinden. Fran und Peter finden die beiden 16-Jährigen sich küssend in Neils Whirlpool.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Der Feind in meinen Träumen
programme.desc: Als Fran ihrem Nachbarn Neil das Leben rettet, hofft sie, dass er ihre Schulden vergisst. Nachdem dieser über dieses Verhalten wütend wird, bekommt Fran erotische Träume von Neil.

programme.title: Happily Divorced: Überraschung mit Folgen
programme.desc: Kurz nachdem Fran von ihrem Nachbarn Neil geküsst wurde, überrascht sie ihren Verlobten Elliot in London. Doch auch er hat eine unangenehme Überraschung für sie.

programme.title: The Exes: Der Einzug
programme.desc: Der kürzlich geschiedene Stuart braucht eine neue Wohnung, also stellt seine Scheidungsanwältin Holly ihm ihre anderen geschiedenen Klienten vor: Phil und Haskell. Stuart zieht zu ihnen in die Wohnung gegenüber von Holly.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Uhren-Kollektion
programme.desc: Phil will einen Freund mit der klein geratenen Eden verkuppeln. Dieser möchte jedoch unbedingt ein Date mit Holly. Währenddessen hilft Haskwell Stuarts Uhren-Kollektion im Internet zu verkaufen.

programme.title: The Exes: Die Kreuzfahrt
programme.desc: Holly verschafft Stuart ein Date mit Katy ohne zu wissen, dass sie ein Call-Girl ist. Derweil versucht Haskell seine Ex-Frau davon zu überzeugen, dass er auf einer Kreuzfahrt ist.

programme.title: The Exes: Der Obdachlose
programme.desc: Haskell möchte, dass statt ihm Phil seine Internet-Freundin Rebecca trifft. Holly verguckt sich in einen Obdachlosen, der im Gebäude seine Wäsche gewaschen hat.

programme.title: Aliens – E.T.s gefährliche Brüder
programme.desc: Gibt es Aliens und könnten sie uns gefährlich werden? Der Film begleitet Wissenschaftler auf ihrer Spurensuche nach Leben im All. Finden sie eine 2. Erde? Gibt es Leben auf dem Mars? Einige Forscher wollen neuerdings Nachrichten an Außerirdische ins...

programme.title: Spacetime: Die dunkle Seite - Schwarze Löcher und unsichtbare Materie
programme.sub-title: Die dunkle Seite - Schwarze Löcher und unsichtbare Materie
programme.desc: Dunkle Materie und Dunkle Energie durchziehen das gesamte All und bestimmen so maßgeblich die Entwicklung unseres Universums. Wissenschaftler Ulrich Walter erklärt die Phänomene.

programme.title: Spacetime: Gravitation - Kraft, die alles zusammenhält
programme.desc: Gravitationswellen sind der Nachweis dafür, dass das Raum-Zeit-Gefüge nicht statisch ist. Doch was ist Gravitation? Und warum ziehen sich Massen an? Ulrich Walter erklärt das Phänomen.

programme.title: Spacetime: Astrobiologie - Suche nach Leben im All
programme.sub-title: Astrobiologie - Suche nach Leben im All
programme.desc: Astronomen identifizieren fortwährend Exoplaneten, die erdähnliche Bedingungen aufweisen. Wissenschaftler Ulrich Walter begibt sich auf die Suche nach unserem Ursprung und dem Leben im All.

programme.title: Spacetime
programme.sub-title: Stille Begleiter - Monde in unserem Planetensystem
programme.desc: Die Erde hat einen, der Mars zwei, Jupiter und Saturn je mehr als 60 - viele Monde umkreisen die Planeten unseres Sonnensystems. Wissenschaftler Ulrich Walter erkundet ihre Eigenschaften.

programme.title: Spacetime: Weltraumschrott - Schnell und gefährlich
programme.desc: Die Menschheit hinterlässt immer mehr Spuren im All. Jede Mission, jeder Start eines Satelliten bedeutet mehr Objekte im Erdorbit. Doch der Abfall bedeutet eine wachsende Gefahr.

programme.title: Spacetime: Reiseziel Mars - Vom Mond zum roten Planeten
programme.sub-title: Reiseziel Mars - Vom Mond zum roten Planeten
programme.desc: Seit Jahrzehnten werden für Erkundungen Rover auf den Mars geschickt, darunter auch „Perseverance“. Astronaut Ulrich Walter erklärt, wieso der rote Planet im Fokus der Raumfahrt steht.

programme.title: Voyager: Expeditionsreise durch das äußere Planetensystem
programme.desc: Dokumentation über die Geschichte der Voyager-Weltraummission, deren zwei Raumsonden nach 35 Jahren und 18 Milliarden Kilometern den Einflussbereich der Sonne verlassen.

programme.title: Apollo 17 – Die letzte Mondlandung: Training für eine ferne Welt
programme.desc: Bei der letzten Mondlandung der NASA sollen mehr Daten erhoben werden als je zuvor.

programme.title: Apollo 17 – Die letzte Mondlandung: Mission im All
programme.desc: Mit dem Weckruf von Mission Control beginnt für die Astronauten Gene Cernan und Jack Schmitt ein neuer Tag auf dem Mond.

programme.title: Destination: Mars
programme.desc: Das internationale Rennen zum roten Planeten läuft auf Hochtouren. Die Eroberung des Mars beflügelt ganz real die Fantasien von hochrangigen Wissenschaftlern, Abenteurern und Scharlatanen.

programme.title: Wettlauf zum Roten Planeten
programme.desc: Mehrere Jahrzehnte nach Neil Armstrongs Mondreise hält ein neuer Wettlauf ins All die Menschheit in Atem.

programme.title: Wettlauf zum Roten Planeten
programme.desc: Der Wettlauf zum Bau der ersten Siedlung auf dem Mars hat begonnen. Wissenschaftler und Ingenieure entwickeln neue Raketen und die nötige Technik.

programme.title: Wettlauf zum Roten Planeten

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Secret War: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.sub-title: The Spymistress and the French Fiasco
programme.desc: After WWII, SOE disbanded, leaving Vera Atkins to uncover fates of 118 agents, including 13 women. Many were betrayed and sent to camps; some were executed. Atkins' quest continued, marked by personal impact and delayed recognition.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Weapons That Changed The World examines the RPG-7, renowned for its ability to take on tanks and level buildings. Host Wil Willis traces its evolution from WWII's Bazooka to modern counterparts like the AT-4 and Carl Gustav.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?
programme.desc: Finland defended itself in the Winter War under Marshal Mannerheim. Finland allied with Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union in 1941. Finland later negotiated peace with the Allies and switched sides as Nazi defeat became apparent.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Artillery, "The King of Battle," has shaped history from ancient cannons to today's M777 Howitzer. Host Wil Willis visits Fort Sill, Oklahoma, to witness modern artillery like the M777 and M109 Paladin in action.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: Mata Hari. Dance, Seduction and Espionage. The enduring myth.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Former U.S. Army Ranger Wil Willis tests modern combat shotguns like the Benelli M4 and Mossberg 590, alongside historic models.This documentary features 3D animations and weapon tests to explore effectiveness of combat shotguns.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programme.desc: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programme.desc: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programme.title: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programme.desc: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: Battle Of Dunkirk
programme.desc: I et kappløp med tiden krysset over åtte hundre private båter Den engelske kanal for å redde de havarerte soldatene fra infernoet på strendene ved Dunkerque. Se de enkelte veteranenes ekstraordinære heltemot i et slag som endret andre verdenskrigs forløp.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: West Of The Divide

programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest music tracks, curated to elevate and inspire positive vibes, offering a refreshing and motivating experience for listeners.
दर्शकों के मनोरंजन के लिए नवीनतम संगीत ट्रैकों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो सकारात्मक भावनाओं को बढ़ाने और प्रेरित करने में मददगार है।

programme.title: Songdew Classics
सॉन्गड्यू क्लासिक्स
programme.desc: The most acclaimed indie classical compositions played consecutively, invoking nostalgia and rekindling cherished memories.
सर्वाधिक प्रशंसित इंडी क्लासिकल रचनाएँ लगातार प्रस्तुत की जाती है, जो पुरानी यादों को ताजा करती हैं और पुरानी यादों को फिर से ताजा करती हैं।

programme.title: Music Dil Se
म्यूज़िक दिल से
programme.desc: Professional Indie music artists share their musical journey and career milestones that contributed to their success in life.
पेशेवर इंडी संगीत कलाकार अपनी संगीत यात्रा और करियर की उपलब्धियाँ साझा करते हैं, जिन्होंने उनकी सफलता में योगदान दिया है।

programme.title: Songdew Fresh
सॉन्गड्यू फ्रेश
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest music tracks, curated to elevate and inspire positive vibes, offering a refreshing and motivating experience for listeners.

programme.title: Friday Night Originals
फ्राइडे नाइट ओरिजिनल्स
programme.desc: Several renowned musicians and bands come together to perform some of their most acclaimed songs in a bid to enthral the audience.

programme.title: New Pinch
न्यू पिंच
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular songs performed and composed by various artists is played back-to-back.
विभिन्न कलाकारों द्वारा संगीतबद्ध कुछ सर्वाधिक लोकप्रिय गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन एक के बाद एक बजाया जाता है।

programme.title: Chai & Chill
चाय एण्ड चिल
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of morning music that offers a soothing and uplifting selection of songs, ensuring positivity and relaxation.

programme.title: Songdew Select
सॉन्गड्यू सेलेक्ट

A csapat lenyomozza a cetlit és kiderül a sajátjuk közül való, így Alexx fia az első számú gyanúsított. A dolog csak súlyosbodik, mikor Alexx megtalája fiát egy raktárépületben, amint egy véres kést tart éppen egyik barátjára felett.

programme.title: X-akták
programme.desc: S08E07 Míg Scully próbálja megőrizni a titkát, Doggett és Skinner összefognak, hogy megtalálják és valahogy megállítsák azt a kegyetlen szektavezért, aki képes álmaikban megölni az embereket.

programme.title: X-akták
programme.desc: S08E08 Doggett és Scully két gyanús testvér után nyomoznak, akik rágcsáló-irtással foglalkozó vállalkozást vezetnek. Minden jel arra vall, hogy a két testvér közül az egyik röntgen-látással rendelkező gyilkos lehet.

programme.title: Cobra 11
programme.desc: S18E08 A lélegzetelállító autósüldözések folytatódnak, a Cobra 11, az európai filmgyártás egyik legsikeresebb akciósorozata visszatér a képernyőkre. Semir Gerkhan és Alex Brandt, az autópálya-rendőrség nyomozói nem kímélik magukat, ha az autópályán közlekedők biztonságáról van szó. Autótolvajok, drogfutárok, fegyvercsempészek, menekülő gyilkosok és ámokfutó autósok - Semir és Alex szürkének aligha mondható hétköznapjainak visszatérő szereplői. Biztonsági öveket bekapcsolni! Indul a Cobra 11! A 19. évad Semir egyre mélyebbre süllyed magánéleti válsága miatt, ami a munkájára is kihat. Az államügyésznő a felmentését kezdeményezi, hacsak nem változik meg rövid időn belül. Semir egyetlen lehetősége, ha talál magának egy társat. Alex Brandt igazán alkalmasnak tűnik: a cserbenhagyott nyomozó két év börtön után szintén társat keres.

programme.title: Medicopter 117 - A légimentők

A szerelvény balesetet szenved, a mozdonyvezető megsérül és a vonat minden irányítás nélkül, egyre nagyobb sebességgel száguld a sínen. Gyors segítséget csak a helikopteres mentőegységtől várhatnak.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E01 Három újonc, Nolan, Lucy és Jackson érkezik a kapitányságra, ahol általában szívesen fogadják őket. Ám John Nolan kivétel. A negyvenéves férfi csődbe ment élete után rendőrként próbál magára találni, és ennek sem a rendőrkapitány, sem pedig a kiképzőtisztek nem örülnek. Úgy vélik, hogy Nolan kapuzárási pánikban szenved, és kora miatt alkalmatlan arra, hogy rendőrként szemlélje az utcát. Csakhogy John Nolan agya másképp van huzalozva, és nemcsak gyorsan tanul, de nem ijed meg az extrém megoldásoktól sem. A 4. évad Nolan rendőrtiszt született tehetség, aki mentális képességeivel ugyanolyan hatékonyan oldja meg a legveszélyesebb ügyeket is, mint fiatal, edzett kollégái. Életében újabb sorsfordító pillanathoz érkezett. Ezúttal nemcsak a saját szakmai karrierjét kell egyengetnie, hanem a következő újonc-generációét is, ráadásul magánélete is rendezésre vár.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S12E22 A helyszínelők csapata három holttest ügyében nyomoz, amiket néhány háztömbnyire találtak egy kampány vacsora helyszínétől. Miután körvonalazódni látszik a gyilkos személye, egy megrázó felfedezést tesznek.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E01 Egy újabb női holttest kerül elő, akit Dante művének, a Pokol 5. körének díszletei között találnak meg. Az áldozat nagy valószínűséggel az egyik egyházi gyülekezetből származik. Russell és Julie tudja, hogy az idejük vészesen fogy, és hamarosan az eltűnt lányok egyike, Morgan vagy Ellie következik a sorozatgyilkos listáján. Ecklie képtelen megbirkózni azzal, hogy a lánya lehet a Pokol következő helyszínének a főszereplője.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E02 Három újonc, Nolan, Lucy és Jackson érkezik a kapitányságra, ahol általában szívesen fogadják őket. Ám John Nolan kivétel. A negyvenéves férfi csődbe ment élete után rendőrként próbál magára találni, és ennek sem a rendőrkapitány, sem pedig a kiképzőtisztek nem örülnek. Úgy vélik, hogy Nolan kapuzárási pánikban szenved, és kora miatt alkalmatlan arra, hogy rendőrként szemlélje az utcát. Csakhogy John Nolan agya másképp van huzalozva, és nemcsak gyorsan tanul, de nem ijed meg az extrém megoldásoktól sem. A 4. évad Nolan rendőrtiszt született tehetség, aki mentális képességeivel ugyanolyan hatékonyan oldja meg a legveszélyesebb ügyeket is, mint fiatal, edzett kollégái. Életében újabb sorsfordító pillanathoz érkezett. Ezúttal nemcsak a saját szakmai karrierjét kell egyengetnie, hanem a következő újonc-generációét is, ráadásul magánélete is rendezésre vár.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E01 Egy kisrepülőgép zuhan le Miami napfényes tengerpartján. Eleinte mindenki műszaki problémára gyanakszik, de mivel a gépet egy tapasztalt pilóta vezette, Horatióék úgy döntenek, hogy jobban utánanéznek az esetnek. A nyomozás során egy kusza szerelmi sokszög kellős közepébe csöppennek, amelynek kibogozása komoly feladat elé állítja a helyszínelőket.

programme.title: Die Piratenbraut
programme.desc: Nachdem ihr Vater hinterlistig ermordet wurde, macht sich Freibeuterin Morgan (Geena Davis) mit einem Drittel der geheimen Schatzkarte ihres Vaters auf den Weg nach Cutthroat Island. Den zweiten Teil der Karte kann sie durch die Befreiung des Schwerenöters William (Matthew Modine) ergattern. Fehlt nur noch ein Teil, doch der ist in den Fängen von Morgans verbrecherischem Onkel Dawg... - Trotz aufwändigen Stunts und Spezialeffekten war "Die Piratenbraut" seinerzeit laut Guinness-Buch der Rekorde der größte kommerzielle Flop des Filmbusiness und spielte nur einen Bruchteil der 100 Millionen Dollar-Produktionskosten ein.

programme.title: Torchwood
programme.desc: Unsterbliches Blut - Die Welt wird durch ein bizarres Phänomen ins Chaos gestürzt: Auf der Erde sterben plötzlich keine Menschen mehr! Was für viele einem Wunder gleichkommt, hat global betrachtet dramatische Konsequenzen. Denn die Abwesenheit von Tod sorgt paradoxerweise für schweres Leid. Als das Gesundheitssystem kollabiert und Vorräte knapp werden, dezimieren Regierungen die Bevölkerung. Jack Harkness (John Barrowman) und Gwen Cooper (Eve Myles) tun sich mit zwei CIA-Profis zusammen, um der Sache auf den Grund zu gehen. Auch der Pharmakonzern "PhiCorp" und mächtige Familienclans sind in die Vorgänge verstrickt. - 4. Staffel der preisgekrönten Sciencefiction-Krimi-Serie.

programme.title: Quatermain - Auf der Suche nach dem Schatz der Könige
programme.desc: Das Drehbuch, das ziemlich frei mit dem Klassiker umspringt, legt vor allem in der ersten Hälfte des Films ein atemberaubendes Tempo vor und jagt von einem Cliffhanger zum nächsten - kaum ist ein Abenteuer knapp überstanden, droht schon die nächste, noch größere Gefahr. Mit viel Pulverdampf, Trubel und Radau hat der Actionroutinier J. Lee Thompson ("Die Kanonen von Navarone") die gelegentlich hirnrissigen Nervenkitzel inszeniert. programme.title: Arabellas Crime Time - Verbrechen im Visier
programme.desc: Caught in the Act - Ein Passant beobachtet, wie eine Frau in ein Auto gezerrt wird. Er will helfen, doch der Angreifer zieht eine Waffe und schießt - aber die Pistole hat eine Ladehemmung. "Arabellas Crime Time" zeigt dramatische Geschichten hinter schockierenden Verbrechen, die viral gehen. Von Profi-Überwachungsgeräten bis hin zu Handycams - fast immer schaut jemand zu. Atemberaubende Clips von Entführungen, Einbrüchen, Verfolgungsjagden und anderen Gewaltverbrechen bringen Millionen von Views ein. Doch diese Doku-Serie geht über das spannende Filmmaterial hinaus, um die ganze Geschichte zu erzählen. Präsentiert werden die Fälle von Moderatorin Arabella Kiesbauer.

programme.title: Code Name Banshee
programme.desc: Caleb (Antonio Banderas) und Delilah, Deckname Banshee (Jaime King), verbindet ein morbides Geheimnis: Sie arbeiten beide als professionelle Auftragskiller! Und es gibt noch eine weitere Gemeinsamkeit. Das Duo hat eine offene Rechnung mit dem Söldner-Boss und Topterroristen Anthony Greene (Tommy Flanagan) zu begleichen. Als Caleb und Delilah die schwerbewaffnete Truppe schonungslos ausradieren, ist absolute Präzision gefragt. Schließlich gerät beim Showdown der Profikiller auch Calebs Tochter Hailey (Catherine Davis) in die Schusslinie. - Das Action-Drama "Mad Bad" von Jon Keeyes wurde beim New Yorker Independent-Filmfestival ausgezeichnet.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Tötet den Mond - 2049 steht die Welt kurz davor, den Mond in die Luft zu jagen. Da die Masse des Erdtrabanten stark zugenommen hat, kommt es zu tödlichen Flutwellen. Der Doktor und Clara fliegen mit dem Space Shuttle von Captain Lundvik (Hermione Norris) zum Mond, wobei sie einige erschreckende Entdeckungen machen. Die Astronaut:innen befinden sich auf einer Selbstmordmission: Sie sollen den lästigen Himmelskörper mit Atombomben pulverisieren! Bei näherer Betrachtung kommt zudem heraus, dass es sich beim Mond in Wahrheit um ein gigantisches Ei handelt. Aber welche Kreatur wird hier in Kürze schlüpfen? Und was bedeutet das für die Zukunft der Menschheit?

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Die Mumie - Als der Timelord und Clara eine interstellare Zugreise antreten, müssen sie eine Reihe rätselhafter Todesfälle aufklären. Die Passagiere im kosmischen Orient-Express werden von einer unsichtbaren Mumie attackiert. Wer die grausige Kreatur erblickt, stirbt exakt in 66 Sekunden! Der Doktor findet heraus, dass es sich bei der Mumie um eine sagenumwobene Entität handelt, die auch als "Prophezeiung" bezeichnet wird. Weitere Detektivarbeit im Weltraumzug bringt ans Licht, dass die Mumie in Wahrheit ein untoter Soldat aus der Zukunft ist, der zum Morden verdammt wurde und futuristische Technologien einsetzt.

programme.desc: Norman Nordstrom (Stephen Lang), ein ehemaliger U.S. Navy SEAL, lebt mit seiner Adoptivtochter Phoenix (Madelyn Grace) zurückgezogen in einem Vorort von Detroit. programme.title: Haus gesucht in Alaska
programme.desc: Homer Improvement - Bären, die Vorräte plündern, Elche im Garten und horrende Heizkosten: Wer in Alaska ein Eigenheim kauft, muss sich auf einiges gefasst machen. Dafür wird man im größten US-Bundesstaat umgeben von Bergen und Seen mit grandiosen Aussichten belohnt. Man kann direkt hinterm Haus angeln oder von der Terrasse aus Wildtiere beobachten. Und wenn man die selbst gefangenen Lachse auf den Grill legt, beschwert sich kein Nachbar. Diese Abgeschiedenheit wissen viele Menschen zu schätzen. Und der Immobilienmarkt lockt mit einem breit gefächerten Angebot. Rustikale Blockhütten und schicke Behausungen mit Sauna und Whirlpool: Diese Serie zeigt die gemütlichsten Eigenheime und stellt ihre Käufer vor.

programme.title: Joyce Meyer - Das Leben genießen
programme.desc: Befreite Hingabe: Was Gott wirklich bei dir sucht - Mit ihrer direkten, humorvollen und zugleich tiefgründigen Art vermittelt die US¿amerikanische Autorin und Bibellehrerin Joyce Meyer alltagsnahe Impulse, die Glauben und Leben miteinander verbinden. In ihren praxisorientierten Botschaften zeigt sie, wie biblische Prinzipien helfen können, Herausforderungen zu meistern, innere Freiheit zu finden und eine neue Haltung zum eigenen Alltag zu entwickeln. Millionen Menschen schätzen ihre authentische, klare Sprache und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Themen verständlich auf den Punkt zu bringen. Die Sendung bietet inspirierende Denkanstöße, die Mut machen und zu persönlicher Veränderung einladen.

programme.title: Blitzschlag - Gefangen im Gewittersturm
programme.desc: Tödliche Blitze und orkanartige Stürme: Über den Nordosten der USA zieht eine gigantische Gewitterfront. Das Mega-Unwetter erstreckt sich von Wisconsin über Chicago und New York bis nach Washington D.C.. Insgesamt sind 7 Bundesstaaten betroffen. Der Klimawissenschaftler Jamie (Mike Dopud), seine neue Freundin Megan (Krista Bridges) und die Kids fahren trotz der bedrohlichen Wetterlage zu einem Familienwochenende in die Natur. Auch Jamies Exfrau Charlotte (Alaina Huffman) ist bei dem Trip dabei, der durch die Wetteranomalie und das Blitzinferno zu einem lebensgefährlichen Albtraum wird. - Low-Budget-Film des kanadischen Regisseurs John L'Ecuyer (u.a. "Curtis's Charm", "ReGenesis").

programme.desc: Angriff auf die Erde: Als eine feindselige Alien-Zivilisation vom Mars aus den Planeten ansteuert, ist es bereits zu spät. Zunächst wird die internationale Raumstation ISS per Laserstrahl zerstört. Danach ist New York City dran. Die Außerirdischen sind monströse Wesen und verfügen über futuristische Technologien. Während die US-Streitkräfte unter dem Kommando von General Reed (Tom Sizemore) zum Gegenschlag ausholen, suchen Astroforscherin Dr. Allison Fischer (Emily Killian) und ihr Bruder Henry (Anthony Jensen) nach alternativen Methoden der Alienbekämpfung. - Science-Fiction-Endzeit-Thriller mit jeder Menge CGI. Regie führte Mario N. Bonassin. Das Drehbuch stammt von Joe Roche.

programme.title: Quatre mariages pour une lune de miel - Saison 12
programme.desc: Le jour de leur mariage, des couples acceptent d'être mis en concurrence avec d'autres, qui notent l'organisation de l'événement sur quatre critères : décoration et choix du lieu, qualité du repas, ambiance générale et la robe de la mariée. Le couple qui obtient la meilleure note se voit offrir la lune de miel de ses rêves. Mais un seul mariage peut remporter la compétition.

programme.title: Quatre mariages pour une lune de miel
programme.desc: Quatre couples mettent en compétition leur mariage. Ils s'invitent mutuellement et se notent sur plusieurs critères. Le dernier jour, ils découvrent leur score ainsi que les commentaires des autres mariés. Et l'un d'eux remporte la lune de miel mise en jeu.

programme.desc: Gru apprend qu'il a un jumeau prénommé Dru. Accompagné de ses filles, de Lucy et des Minions, il finit par faire la connaissance de ce frère inattendu. programme.title: Les Bad Guys
programme.desc: M. Loup, M. Serpent, M. Requin, M. Piranha et Mlle Tarentule, réunis dans le gang des Bad Guys, sont des criminels activement recherchés. Le jour où ils sont arrêtés et menacés de prison, M. Loup propose un deal à la police : la relaxe contre leur promesse de devenir des citoyens modèles...

programme.title: Domi Kids

programme.title: Chefclub Kids
programme.desc: With Chefclub Kids, the little ones get their hands dirty all while having fun in the kitchen. Whether they're learning to prepare dinner, bake goodies, or explore new flavors, Chefclub Kids is a way for children to gain confidence through cooking!

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Misha, the Purple Cat
programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. Many things can happen in Misha’s world; especially exciting adventures, mysterious investigations, hilarious competitions... all with a feeling of close friendship.

The show features a wide range of themes, diverse scenes, and captivating content. A professional music production team ensures high-quality melodies, arrangements, and vocals, creating a true audiovisual feast for children.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

programme.title: Counting With Paula
programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Princess Play Time
programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Bino & Fino
programme.desc: Bino & Fino is about a brother and sister named Bino and Fino who live with their grandparents 'Mama' and 'Papa' in a modern day city in Africa. Bino and Fino have many adventures where, with the help of their friend Zeena the Magic Butterfly, they discover and learn things about the world.

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: Horaci the Inuit
programme.desc: Packed with adventure, fun and excitement, HORACI THE INUIT will transport you to the Lands of the North where, together with his best friend Sedna, he will have to solve all kinds of mysteries! Horaci the Inuit takes place in a remote village and talks about universal values such as caring for nature, being intuitive and open-minded and, above all, having a loving respect for family and friends!

programme.desc: The proud Princess likes to do things her own way, but her antics are always joined by her restless brother, Prince, who tends to turn everything topsy-turvy. Any playtime in their room transforms into a fantastic journey through unusual worlds: the children arrange a picnic on the Moon, conduct a detective investigation in a toy city, or search for pirate treasures on islands! Although initially, the Princess and Prince seem to clash and compete, by the end, they always find joy in each other's company and that of their cherished dog, Bona.

programme.title: Baby Riki
programme.desc: The show covers all aspects of a child’s life from physical well-being to cognitive and soft skills. The musical stories are based around age-appropriate experiences with educational concepts introduced in familiar surroundings and context for infants.

programme.title: Talking Tom and Friends Minis
programme.desc: Get ready to watch Talking Tom and Friends at their cutest! Mini in size, but massive in fun, the Minis check out the day-to-day world of the friends we all know and love where they do the most ordinary things in the most extraordinary ways.

programme.title: Leo the Wildlife Ranger
programme.desc: Leo the Wildlife Ranger introduces the secrets and wonders of nature and wildlife around us and kickstarts a curiosity and passion for nature in kids. With engaging missions and adventures, kids have fun while learning positive lessons!

programme.title: Counting With Paula
programme.desc: The show features Paula and her friends, Tim, Billy, Chalky, Calc, and the Numbers as they go on exciting adventures in colorful and exotic places. From the Amazon jungles to the deepest oceans, and to the hottest deserts, Paula and friends solve problems, have fun and make more friends along the way!

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Ebb and Flo
programme.desc: The world of Ebb and Flo is seen through Ebb’s eyes and Ebb reveals all the emotions grown-ups try to hide. Flo doesn’t think of Ebb as a dog, and Ebb doesn’t think of Flo as a small human, they just are the best of friends. Until Bird arrives to lovingly disrupt Ebb’s world. Ebb and Flo’s home is an old boat moored by the beach. Things Couldn’t Be Better!

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Sweety Special
स्वीटी स्पेशल
ஸ்வீட்டி ஸ்பெஷல்
స్వీటీ స్పెషల్
programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.
స్వీటీ అనే మహిళ, ప్రజల దైనందిన జీవితాలు, సంబంధిత అనుభవాలను గుర్తుచేసే హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలోకి వస్తుంది.

programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

यार मेरा सूपरस्टार

programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

मस्करी
மஸ்கரி

programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.

సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.desc: A woman named Sweety gets into comedic situations that are reminiscent of people's daily lives and relatable experiences.
स्वीटी नाम की एक महिला ऐसी हास्य स्थितियों में फंस जाती है जो लोगों के दैनिक जीवन और संबंधित अनुभवों की याद दिलाती है।
ஸ்வீட்டி, மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கை மற்றும் தொடர்புடைய அனுபவங்களை நினைவூட்டும் நகைச்சுவையான சூழ்நிலைகளில் ஈடுபடுகிறார்.

programme.title: Tenali Rama
तेनाली रामा
தெனாலி ராமா
తెనాలి రామ
programme.desc: Court poet Tenali Rama serves at the court of Emperor Krishnadevaraya of the Vijayanagara empire and uses his sharp wit and wisdom to solve complicated matters quickly.
तेनाली रामा, विजयनगर साम्राज्य के सम्राट कृष्णदेवराय के दरबार में कवि और सलाहकार हैं। वह, राज्य और जनता के कठिन मामलों को सुलझाने के लिए अपनी तेज बुद्धि का उपयोग करते हैं।
தெனாலிராமன், சிக்கலான விஷயங்களை விரைவாகத் தீர்க்க தனது கூர்மையான புத்திசாலித்தனத்தையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறார்.
విజయనగర సామ్రాజ్య చక్రవర్తి శ్రీ కృష్ణదేవరాయల ఆస్థాన కవి తెనాలి రాముడు, తన తెలివితో క్లిష్టమైన సమస్యలను పరిష్కరిస్తాడు.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.

programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

ஜாதுய் நகரி

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.
